description: Find authors on BookGather by name, genre or location. Set bookable_only to list authors who accept bookings for school visits, library programs, book clubs, signings, festivals or virtual visits, with their posted fee range. Returns genres, books, booking details and the profile link where a host can send a booking request.

bookable_only.description: Only authors who have marked themselves available for bookings.

location.description: City or state the author is based in.
